Per-unit Pearson scores of the directed layer (C++ kernel)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
cpp_dag_scores.Rd

The unit contribution of the coefficients of node j is eps_ij r[i, P_j] / delta_j, with eps_ij = r[i, j] - gamma_j' r[i, P_j], and that of its innovation variance is (eps_ij^2 - delta_j) / (2 delta_j^2). Summed over units these are the estimating functions whose root is cpp_dag_closed_root(), and their outer product is the variability of the sandwich.

Usage

cpp_dag_scores(Ec, gamma, delta, edge_idx)

Arguments

Ec

n x R matrix of centered Pearson residuals.

gamma

coefficients in the order of edge_idx.

delta

vector of R innovation variances.

edge_idx

integer |E| x 2 matrix of edges, 1-based.

Value

list with scores (n x (|E| + R), in the order (gamma, delta)) and innovations (n x R).
